title: Brahmapurana
source: sa_brahmapurANa-1-246.txt; GRETIL (gretil.sub.uni-goettingen.de), CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (data entry: Peter Schreiner and Renate Soehnen-Thieme)
reply:
Reading the verses:

15.59 lists names: Nyagrodha, Sunāmā, Kaṅka, Subhūṣaṇa, Rāṣṭrapāla, Sutanu, Anāvṛṣṭi. The verse itself states no relation between them. 15.60 says "teṣām svasāraḥ pañcāsan", so they had five sisters: Kaṃsā, Kaṃsavatī, Sutanū, Rāṣṭrapālī, Kaṅkā. The "teṣām" refers to the brothers named in 15.59 (and probably Kaṃsa earlier, but that is not named here). I will give each sister as sister_of the brothers; the brothers named in 15.59 number seven, and five sisters times seven brothers is 35 statements. That is too many and the reference is unclear, so I give the sisters as sister_of Nyagrodha, the first-named brother, with doubt true.

15.61: Ugrasena is "kukurodbhavaḥ", born in the Kukura line. This is descendant_of Kukura, with the words "kukurodbhavaḥ". The line is "kukurāṇām vaṃśam", so the Kukuras are named after Kukura; I give line_of Kukura, since the text says "kukurāṇām imaṃ vaṃśam".

I will record the sisters as sister_of Nyagrodha with doubt true, and Ugrasena as descendant_of Kukura.
